countries_thin_or_null: Cambodia — older DSBB references SNA 1993 implementation in progress; recent IMF Data ROSC (2026) notes mixed alignment with international standards and ongoing methodological improvements under EU Twinning and planned IMF resident advisor; limited public primary pages naming current full SNA edition

Timor-Leste — thinner overall; institution restructured as INETL (independent public institute) in 2023; joined ASEAN as full member in October 2025; e-GDDS participation confirmed but detailed SNA/COICOP methodology statements scarce in primary sources

proposed_reports.title: Department of Statistics Malaysia (DOSM)
proposed_reports.description: Official national statistics office of Malaysia responsible for collecting, interpreting and disseminating official statistics including national accounts, CPI, labour force and population data; also operates OpenDOSM open data portal.

proposed_reports.title: Malaysia National Accounts / GDP (Annual and Quarterly)
proposed_reports.description: Annual and quarterly GDP estimates by production, expenditure and income approaches at current and constant prices; includes state-level annual GDP; base-year updates (e.g. 2015).

proposed_reports.title: Malaysia Consumer Price Index (CPI)
proposed_reports.description: Monthly CPI by division (2-digit COICOP groups) measuring changes in prices of goods and services; national-level series disseminated via OpenDOSM.

proposed_reports.title: National Institute of Statistics (NIS)
proposed_reports.publisher: National Institute of Statistics, Ministry of Planning, Kingdom of Cambodia
proposed_reports.description: Official national statistics office of Cambodia responsible for national accounts, CPI, socio-economic surveys and censuses; recently designated a Public Administrative Establishment (PAE) in 2025 for greater autonomy.

proposed_reports.title: Cambodia National Accounts / GDP
proposed_reports.description: Annual and quarterly national accounts aggregates compiled by NIS; subject of ongoing methodological improvements via EU Twinning and planned IMF technical assistance.

proposed_reports.title: Lao Statistics Bureau (LSB)
proposed_reports.publisher: Lao Statistics Bureau, Ministry of Planning and Investment, Lao PDR
proposed_reports.description: Official national statistics office of Lao PDR (secretariat-equivalent under Ministry of Planning and Investment); focal point for official statistics, coordination of the national statistical system, and dissemination via LAOSIS database and e-GDDS.

proposed_reports.title: Lao PDR National Accounts / GDP
proposed_reports.description: Annual (and some quarterly) GDP estimates by production and expenditure approaches; series under transition toward fuller 2008 SNA implementation.

proposed_reports.title: Department of Economic Planning and Statistics (DEPS) — Department of Statistics
proposed_reports.publisher: Department of Economic Planning and Statistics, Ministry of Finance and Economy, Brunei Darussalam
proposed_reports.description: Official body responsible for national socio-economic statistics in Brunei Darussalam (Department of Statistics within DEPS); compiles and disseminates national accounts, CPI, balance of payments and other official statistics under the Statistics Act.

proposed_reports.title: Brunei Darussalam National Accounts / GDP
proposed_reports.description: Quarterly and annual national accounts statistics compiled in accordance with 1993/2008 SNA concepts; includes production, income and expenditure approaches and Supply-Use/Input-Output tables.

proposed_reports.title: Instituto Nacional de Estatística de Timor-Leste (INETL) / National Institute of Statistics of Timor-Leste
proposed_reports.publisher: Instituto Nacional de Estatística de Timor-Leste (INETL, I.P.)
proposed_reports.description: Official national statistics office of Timor-Leste (formerly General Directorate of Statistics / GDS under Ministry of Finance); established as an independent public institute by Decree Law No. 04/2023; responsible for national accounts, CPI, population and labour statistics.

proposed_reports.title: Timor-Leste National Accounts / GDP
proposed_reports.publisher: Instituto Nacional de Estatística de Timor-Leste (INETL)
proposed_reports.description: National accounts and GDP estimates compiled by INETL; disseminated under e-GDDS framework via National Summary Data Page.

dependencies.basis: DOSM compiles national accounts data in accordance with the System of National Accounts 2008 (2008 SNA); analytical framework and definitions follow 2008 SNA; COICOP used for household consumption.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Analytical framework: The data are compiled in accordance with the methodology set out in the System of National Accounts 2008 (2008 SNA).

dependencies.basis: Household consumption expenditure in national accounts and CPI classification use COICOP.
dependencies.evidence_quote: COICOP is used for household consumption and COFOG is applied to government consumption, whereby the data is available on annual basis.

dependencies.basis: Malaysia participates in the IMF Special Data Dissemination Standard (SDDS); national accounts and other categories are disseminated under SDDS with certified metadata.
dependencies.evidence_quote: Special Data Dissemination Standard ... Malaysia National accounts ... Last Certified: Jan 22, 2026

dependencies.basis: Malaysia is a full ASEAN member; DOSM participates in and chairs ASEAN Community Statistical System (ACSS) activities (e.g. ACSS15 under Malaysia's 2025 ASEAN chairmanship).
dependencies.evidence_quote: ASEAN-Malaysia 2025 Chairmanship: The Department of Statistics Malaysia (DOSM) will chair the 15th ASEAN Community Statistical System Committee (ACSS15) which aims to strengthen the statistical cooperation towards sustainable regional development.
